data.narrative:
Breen Energy is a seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $3M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes nine known private peers (Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen among them) and one relevant public comparable (LNZA), though no peers share identical stage and valuation characteristics with sufficient density for direct median benchmarking.

The stage-progression method is applicable here. Using total raised ($3M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $8M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within narrow valuation bands; while the Climate & Energy universe is reasonably populated, Breen Energy's specific position lacks three or more sufficiently analogous datapoints.

The triangulation yields a median valuation of $8M, with a low estimate of $6M and a high estimate of $9M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around (1) whether the 2.5x multiplier accurately captures this specific subsector's step-up dynamics, and (2) the absence of peer-derived cross-validation. Given limited data density, this range should be treated as directional rather than definitive, and updating it will require either identification of tighter peer comparables or additional performance or financing data from the target.
